The '''Inner Moon''' was a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located in the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]]. It was one of two moons that orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] and was closer to it than the [[Outer Moon|other moon]]. It had no atmosphere and low gravity. In about [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ship ''[[Good Feeling]]'' crashed there, after being attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]]. However, after a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] operatives came to the rescue, the ship was able to leave the moon.
